about_the_game:
Overview:

"Life Garden" is a unique life simulation game where you paint each day of your life with flowers and grass. In this poetic journey, you'll witness the flow of time, record life's moments, and cultivate your own garden of the soul.

This is not just a game - it's a mirror reflecting life, a diary recording growth, and a garden preserving memories.

Key Features:

🌸 Flowers of Life

• Plant a flower or grass for each day

• Record your daily mood through different plants

• Watch your life garden bloom with time

📖 Soul Diary

• Write personal diaries for special days

• Document life's precious moments

• Reflect on the past and look to the future

⏳ Time Imprint

• Visualize your life journey

• Experience the flow and accumulation of time

• Cherish the present and plan for the future

🎯 Achievement System

• Set personal goals and track progress

• Unlock unique achievements and milestones

• Gain a sense of accomplishment in growth

✨ Healing Experience

• Clean and elegant interface design

• Relaxing and joyful interactions

• Immersive mental relaxation time

🌍 Multi-language Support

• Supports Chinese, English, Japanese, and more

• Accessible global experience

• Connect with players worldwide

This game is perfect for anyone who:

• Wants to record life's moments

• Seeks inner peace

• Loves life planning

• Enjoys collecting achievements

• Pursues spiritual growth

Create your own life garden and let each day bloom with your unique colors.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 (64位)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 或 AMD同等级处理器
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 支持OpenGL 3.3的显卡
  • DirectX: Version 5.2
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX兼容声卡
